name: Forehead Texture
description: Analyzes forehead micro-pattern and 文本ure
algorithm: Forehead Texture — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes forehead skin texture for deepfake detection:

1. **Forehead区域提取**: The forehead region is segmented per frame — bounded by hairline, eyebrows, and temples. This region is geometrically normalized to compensate for head tilt and provide consistent texture analysis across frames.

2. **Multi-Scale纹理分析**: Forehead texture is analyzed at multiple scales: macro (expression wrinkles, vein visibility), meso (pores, fine wrinkles), and micro (skin grain, peach fuzz). Natural foreheads exhibit characteristic texture at each scale. AI-generated foreheads often show texture quality that drops off at finer scales.

3. **Expression-纹理相关性**: Forehead texture changes predictably with expressions — horizontal wrinkles appear with brow raising (frontalis contraction), vertical wrinkles with brow furrowing (corrugator contraction). The method verifies that texture changes correlate correctly with detected expressions. Deepfakes may show expression without corresponding wrinkle formation.

4. **Sweat/SebumIndicator分析**: Real foreheads show subtle specular highlights from skin oils/perspiration, with characteristic spatial distribution. The method detects these physiological indicators — AI generators typically don't model skin surface moisture, producing either uniformly matte or uniformly shiny foreheads.

5. **时间纹理稳定性**: Fine forehead texture (pore positions, stable wrinkles) should remain fixed across frames. The method tracks micro-texture consistency — frame-to-frame variations in pore patterns or shifting wrinkle positions indicate per-frame independent rendering by AI generators.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through forehead 文本ure analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频
